content:
ana_product: Heads-up: BigEdu wants us to sunset text-embed-v1 (1024 dim) in favor of text-embed-plus (1536 dim) next quarter. They requested a mitigation plan: bench validation, migration tooling, pin options, and a clear customer comm timeline. Can we outline an onboarding + deprecation flow that meets their enterprise SLAs?

devon_engineering: Quick notes from infra: embed-plus is ~10% faster on long docs but cold-start p95 can be worse due to larger KV footprints. We should include a measured warmup step for heavy-indexing jobs. Also need a catalog flag to support a temporary 'compat-mode' that returns v1 dims via server-side downscaling.

talia_research: For quality gates, propose an "interop-suite" of tests: 1) semantic parity (cosine delta <= 0.015 across 10k bilingual pairs), 2) downstream rerank AUC delta <= 0.005, and 3) retrieval recall lift >= 0.02 on our enterprise corpora. Canaries must pass all three.

omar_sre: Ops requirements: rollout metadata fields in catalog entries - fields: `deprecation_date`, `pin_allowed`, `soft_fallback_window_days`, `compat_mode`. Rollouts should auto-abort if embed_latency.p95 > baseline.p95 * 1.25 for >10 minutes OR if interop-suite failures spike. We can wire alerts to #incidents and create a deploy-runbook template.

joy_sales: BigEdu wants a 6-month pin TTL and a "contracted-pin" feature so they can guarantee v1 for critical endpoints until their vendors upgrade. They'll pay for additional dual-run compute during the transition. Can we support invoicing credits for participation in an early migration cohort?

migration-bot: Migration job created: jobs/catalog/migrate-bigedu-canary started at 1812223360. Metrics tracked: interop-suite, latency-p50/p95, and migration-cost-estimate.

devon_engineering: Draft catalog lifecycle entry (pseudocode) below — includes a soft-deprecation path and a dual-run opt-in: 

```
catalog_entry:
  model_name: text-embed-plus-1536
  stable_aliases: [text-embed-v1-compat, text-embed-plus]
  lifecycle:
    status: soft_deprecate
    deprecation_date: "2026-09-01"
    pin_allowed: true
    pin_ttl_days: 180
    soft_fallback_window_days: 90
    compat_mode: server_downscale_v1
  rollout:
    canary_fraction: 0.03
    canary_cohorts: [bigedu, synthetic_search_load]
    abort_conditions: [latency_p95>1.25x, interop_failures>5m]
```

ana_product: A couple caveats: server_downscale_v1 will not perfectly match v1 numeric space; we must flag downstream SDKs and the docs. Also surface an alert to tenant admins when compat-mode is used for >30 days.

joy_sales: Request: include migration playbook bullets for procurement team — credits, opt-in window, and invoice code. Will draft with legal.

talia_research: Suggest we run a 2-week dual-run in which we emit both vectors (v1 & plus) behind `dual_run=true` so customers can run side-by-side analytics. This helps validate the interop-suite in production for each tenant. Estimated cost multiplier 1.5x for the canary cohort.

omar_sre: I'll scope the runbook: warmup plan for heavy indexing, how to abort and rollback, and post-mortem checklist. Also need a migration dashboard (per-tenant) showing dimension mismatches, avg cosine delta, and API error rates.

ana_product: Action summary: 1) Devon -> add lifecycle fields + compat_mode implementation prototype and cost estimate by Wed EOD. 2) Talia -> publish interop-suite test harness and pass/fail thresholds; run on offline corpora by Thu. 3) Omar -> runbook + dashboard spec and alert thresholds by Mon. 4) Joy -> draft commercial credit offer and contracted-pin wording for legal by next Tuesday. 5) All -> agree on deprecation_date and public comm draft in our next sync.

migration-bot: Next scheduled metric snapshot at 1812223390.

ana_product: Thanks team — want the pilot proposal to include concrete customer migration steps (CLI example, schema migration guide, and a small mapping snippet). Example CLI for customers: `rw-migrate --from text-embed-v1 --to text-embed-plus --dual-run 14d`. We'll circulate the proposal to BigEdu after the above deliverables are in.

devon_engineering: Noted. I'll prototype `compat_mode` as a pluggable transformer so we can iterate without perf regressions.

joy_sales: +1, holding customer expectation: no breaking API changes; plan to share a technical FAQ.

ana_product: Closing — follow-ups in the doc and we'll reconvene next Tue."
